correctness.rationale: For smooth centered radial forces of polynomial growth, the stationary OU driver and axial convolution exist and have all moments. The reversible radial OU generator is diagonalized by orthonormal Laguerre modes with rates 2m. The exact stationary Stratonovich current/heat identity yields Sigma=(1/eta)sum_m (2m/(eta+2m)) a_m^2. Strict weight ordering proves the global unique optimizer, sharp gap, all equality cases, and optimal unattained upper bound. Independent raw polynomial-generator stationary moments agree with the spectral identity in 189 exact rational assertions; finite checks support but do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The variational domain is fixed by a natural physical budget (stationary mean-square nonconservative force), not arbitrary numerical parameters. The theorem identifies a sharp thermodynamic optimum for the baseline quadratic optical force among every smooth radial polynomial-growth alternative, gives a universal exact excess-dissipation spectral gap and equality class, and finds an unattained opposite extremum. This is a model-specific structural classification, not just a numerical moment evaluation. Optical realizability beyond the paraxial model and finite-sample estimation remain outside scope.
